sandpaper.screen.title: Mod settings
sandpaper.config.numberRefused: %s is not a whole number between %s and %s. Leave this field to restore the set value.
sandpaper.config.colourRefused: %s is not a colour. Use a name, or six or eight hex digits. Leave this field to restore the set colour.
sandpaper.config.group.budgets.desc: How much of a frame background work may claim.
sandpaper.option.render_share.desc: Percent of a free frame the render lane may claim.
sandpaper.option.tick_share.desc: Percent of a tick the tick lane may claim.
sandpaper.option.floor.desc: The budget always granted, even when frames are already over target.
sandpaper.option.render_ceiling.desc: The most the render lane is ever granted in one frame, however much headroom there is.
sandpaper.option.tick_ceiling.desc: The most the tick lane is ever granted in one tick, however much headroom there is.
sandpaper.option.apply_per_tick.desc: Finished results applied on the main thread per tick.
sandpaper.config.group.threads.desc: This machine reports %2$s processors. The automatic setting uses %1$s workers. Needs a restart.
sandpaper.option.worker_threads.desc: Zero sizes it from the machine: processors minus two, capped at six. Needs a restart.
sandpaper.option.queue_capacity.desc: Bounds both halves of the pool: jobs waiting for a worker, and finished results waiting to be handed back on the main thread. Needs a restart.
sandpaper.option.treatment.desc: Choose the look used for settings panels and fields.
sandpaper.option.theme_colour.desc: Recolours the Aero panels, fields and buttons.
sandpaper.option.theme_colour_custom.des: A name or hex colour for the theme, used only while theme colour is set to Custom.
sandpaper.option.accent_colour.desc: Recolours the selected page, switches, sliders, headings and lines.
sandpaper.option.accent_colour_custom.de: A name or hex colour for the accent, used only while accent colour is set to Custom.
sandpaper.option.debug_readout.desc: Adds lane budgets, queue depth and worker state to the debug screen (F3).
sandpaper.option.verbose_logging.desc: Adds detail to the log about the background work the scheduler is running.
sandpaper.option.font_face.desc: Which face the settings screen letters with.
sandpaper.option.font_scope.desc: How far the chosen face reaches: settings and map lettering, or every font in the game.
sandpaper.option.font_size.desc: Percent of the size that makes this face's capitals as tall as the game's own.
sandpaper.option.font_oversample.desc: Above one keeps a scaled label crisp.
sandpaper.option.font_add.desc: Opens your system's file chooser and copies what you pick into the fonts folder, then selects it. Greyed out where the game's own file dialog cannot be reached; use the folder button below instead.
sandpaper.option.font_folder.desc: Opens the folder the list above is built from.
sandpaper.toast.save_failed.title: Sandpaper settings not saved
sandpaper.toast.settings_not_saved.title: Settings not saved
sandpaper.toast.settings_not_saved.body: Some settings not saved. Check the log
sandpaper.toast.stage_failed.title: Setting not carried over
sandpaper.toast.stage_failed.body: Setting not applied. Check the log
sandpaper.toast.rebuild_refused.title: Screen not rebuilt
sandpaper.toast.rebuild_refused.body: Not changed. Try again when saving finishes
sandpaper.toast.font_pick_dropped.title: Font not selected
sandpaper.toast.font_pick_dropped.body: Font copied, not selected. Open settings to choose it
